points.K1: 生物因子威胁公众健康
points.S1: 评估看什么，何时再评估

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼前，身旁浮现三个台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laboratory building with three floating step icons beside it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 生物风险怎么管？今天讲三步。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白课程表，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank course schedule and frowns in a laboratory corridor.
shots.narration: 阿杰要进微生物实验室做课题。

shots.scene: 阿杰问小研，小研指向墙上的流程图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the female graduate student a question; she points to a wall chart with three icons.
shots.narration: 他问：进门之前，要先做什么？

shots.scene: 小研竖起三根手指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up three fingers and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：记住三步就有方向。

shots.section_title: 生物因子威胁公众健康
shots.scene: 实验楼外一圈人群图标，中间有微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory building in the center surrounded by small people outline icons, with a microbe icon above the building. No people.
shots.narration: 生物因子一旦失控，
overlay: 生物因子威胁公众健康

shots.section_title: 生物因子威胁公众健康
shots.scene: 人群图标上出现黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Yellow warning triangles appear over the people outline icons around the building. No people.
shots.narration: 会威胁公众的健康和安全。

shots.scene: 细菌、病毒和其他病原体的卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon icons of a bacterium, a virus particle and another round pathogen floating in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒和其他病原体，

shots.scene: 放大镜下才看见的小颗粒飘向健康人图标
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifier, tiny particles drift toward a healthy person outline icon. No people.
shots.narration: 肉眼看不见，却能让健康人生病。

shots.scene: 三个台阶，分别画放大镜、盾牌、对勾
shots.prompt_en: Three steps going up, with a magnifier icon, a shield icon and a check mark icon on each step. No people.
shots.narration: 管理生物风险，有三个基本步骤。

shots.scene: 老周和小研在桌前看空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student sit at a desk reviewing a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 第一步，风险评估。

shots.scene: 评估表上画着病原图标和人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank form with a pathogen icon on one side, a person outline icon on the other and an arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 看病原会给做实验的人带来什么风险。

shots.scene: 王老师在旁边审阅签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews the blank form and signs it, while the older man watches.
shots.narration: 负责人组织评估，管理人员审核。

shots.scene: 阿杰也坐在桌边认真听
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at the desk too, listening and nodding.
shots.narration: 做实验的人，也要参与和了解。

shots.scene: 五块积木叠成一面墙
shots.prompt_en: Five building blocks stacked into a protective wall, each with a different icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，风险减缓。

shots.scene: 风险箭头撞到积木墙后变小
shots.prompt_en: A large red risk arrow hits the five-block wall and comes out the other side as a small orange arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用五类控制措施，把风险降下来。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜前操作，穿戴防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab gown, gloves and goggles, works at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 设施、规程、防护用品一起上。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the laboratory holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第三步，绩效评估。

shots.scene: 检查表上一项项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist being ticked item by item with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 看控制措施选得对不对，

shots.scene: 老李测试设备，指示灯为绿色
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests a biological safety cabinet; a green indicator light shines on its blank panel.
shots.narration: 设备和防护有没有正常工作。

shots.scene: 一项打红叉，旁边画修理扳手
shots.prompt_en: One checklist item gets a red X with a wrench icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题，马上改进。

shots.scene: 三个台阶连成循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: The three step icons join into a circle of arrows that keeps turning. No people.
shots.narration: 三步连起来，就是生物风险管理。

shots.scene: 循环每转一圈上升一层
shots.prompt_en: The turning circle of arrows rises like a spiral. No people.
shots.narration: 一轮接一轮，不断改进。

shots.section_title: 评估看什么，何时再评估
shots.scene: 评估表上出现四个图标：病原、操作、人员、设施
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form with four icons: a microbe, a pipette, a person outline and a laboratory room. No people.
shots.narration: 评估要看病原、操作、人和设施。
overlay: 评估看什么，何时再评估

shots.section_title: 评估看什么，何时再评估
shots.scene: 离心机、移液枪旁画出气溶胶小点
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a centrifuge and a pipette with small aerosol dots around them. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会产生气溶胶，要重点看。

shots.section_title: 评估看什么，何时再评估
shots.scene: 新样品盒、新仪器和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a new sample box, a new instrument and a calendar with a circled date. No people.
shots.narration: 换病原、换方法、换设施，

shots.section_title: 评估看什么，何时再评估
shots.scene: 红色感叹号与重新开始的评估表
shots.prompt_en: A red exclamation icon next to a fresh blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 或出了事故，都要重新评估。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白说明书选消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two disinfectant bottles with blank labels against a blank instruction sheet.
shots.narration: 台面消毒，先选对消毒剂。

shots.scene: 喷洒后台面保持湿润，旁边一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A wet bench surface after spraying disinfectant, with a timer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 喷完要让台面湿着，等够作用时间。

shots.scene: 日历上标着配制日期的消毒剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a blank date tag next to a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按说明配制，注明日期，别用过期的。

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套和护目镜擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench with gloves and goggles on.
shots.narration: 配制和擦拭时，也要做好防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套，在水池前洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves and washes his hands carefully at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 摘下手套，离开前一定要洗手。

shots.scene: 洗手步骤的六个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Six small icons showing handwashing steps: palms, backs, between fingers, thumbs, fingertips, wrists. No people.
shots.narration: 掌心、手背、指缝，都要搓到。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯和零食被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A water cup, a snack and a lipstick on a lab bench, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃、不喝、不化妆。

shots.scene: 手机放在样品旁被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mobile phone lying next to sample tubes on a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，别碰手机和脸。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三个台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating step icons with a magnifier, a shield and a check mark.
shots.narration: 先评估，再控制，后检查。

shots.scene: 评估表、消毒剂瓶、洗手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank assessment form, a disinfectant bottle with a timer, and washing hands. No people.
shots.narration: 情况变了就再评估，消毒等够时间。

shots.scene: 洗手与禁止饮食图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of washing hands and a crossed-out cup. No people.
shots.narration: 勤洗手，实验室里不吃喝。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the laboratory building.
shots.narration: 三步走稳，生物安全，下次见！
